svg.title: Unlimited frame mapping
svg.desc: Bytes 48 69 21 00 FF to bit string, 5-bit symbols, Gray and rotation, and tone indexes 14 6 2 11 23 25 3 24 between START and STOP.
svg.text: Frame mapping: the spec 1.5 vector (k 5, N 8)
5 bytes → 40-bit string, MSB first → 8 symbols of k bits → gray⁻¹ → + (i − 1)·r mod 32 (r = 5) → tone index n_i
Receiver: s_i = gray((n_i − (i − 1)·r) mod M) = peak_symbol(n_i, i − 1, k). De-rotated neighbouring tones differ in one bit,
so an adjacent-tone error costs one bit; the rotation spreads repeated bytes over the band.
Every value is computed by the library: peak_tone, peak_symbol, gray_decode, tone_rotation.
Frequencies for the hf preset: f_n = f_ref − (5 + 8n/7)/T with f_ref 2132 Hz, T 32 ms.
